title: Part, item, contract, difficulty descriptions cut to one line
body: parts/consumables/contracts/difficulties descriptions were 45-80 chars shown in every shop card; now <=34.

title: Career objective and result messages shortened
body: objective() and CareerResult messages were up to 69 chars; now <=48, verbs kept.

title: Market, garage and ally-reward rejections shortened
body: e.g. "No useful unlocked part on this car - choose another car or reward" -> "No useful part - pick another"; sentinels kept.

title: Controller layout and campaign tutorial copy cut
Copy-budget test
body: CopyBudgetTest fails when a table description (<=34/48/60) or a runtime message (<=48) grows.

title: Debt line "League debt N CR / optional loans N CR" is the phone-side overflow: render two chips (League N / Loan N), drop the totals receipt paragraph behind a "Receipts" tap
body: Core already sends debt, loanDebt, initial, interest, paid, diverted, recovered, voided as numbers; the sentence is built in the controller (debtText line 53, campaignTotals line 58 of ~220 chars). Needs controller change, not data.

title: Market status line packs 7 items ("PR / Hull / Optional loans / Last repayment / Bonus / Utility slots")
body: Replace with Hull bar + credits; loans/PR behind a detail tap. Jargon PR and CR are never expanded.

title: Parts/items/contracts all show name + " / price CR" + description on every card; hide description behind tap, show one line only for the focused card
body: Data is now short enough for a single line, but 6 parts + 4 items + 3 contracts = 13 paragraphs at once.

title: Ally reward offer label appends " / "+reason, so a disabled offer shows two sentences
body: Core exposes available+reason separately; show reason as a subline or tooltip.

title: campaign.mechanic ("line") is a spoken character line shown as UI text beside tutorial and hub
body: Three strings per act on one screen; core could expose a short "hint" field = tutorial only and let the phone drop the voice line. Field exists (tutorial); consumer should ignore "line".

title: Story cards: three lines of up to 78 chars each (line1-3) plus 190-char campaign-beats beat
body: Owned by narrative/lines.csv (voice-tied); cutting text means re-recording audio. TV caption slot should show line1 only, lines 2-3 on advance.

title: Jargon in the economy: CR, PR, tier, cup points, trophies have no first-use expansion; "Debt" means two things (league debt vs optional loan)
body: Pick one word each: "Crew debt" / "Loan"; show CR as the coin glyph on both screens.

title: lines.csv voice_direction up to 137 chars and tracks.csv lesson (84) are authoring fields; confirm no consumer prints them
body: Grep found none on phone/TV; keep out of any JSON before it is added.
